standard_prerequisites.name: Separatedness of Proj
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the uniqueness part of the criterion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Valuations
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the value group Gamma and the valuation v of A.

standard_prerequisites.name: Coverage by standard opens
standard_prerequisites.use: The D_+(x_i) cover Proj(S), so some generator image is nonzero at the K-point.

core_obligations: Existence: choose f with the K-point inside D_+(f), renumber so phi(x_i^{deg(f)}/f^{d_i}) is nonzero exactly for i at most r, and pick i_0 minimizing gamma_i = (d/d_i) v(phi(x_i^{deg(f)}/f^{d_i})).
Factor phi through S_{(f x_0)}; the displayed valuation inequality shows S_{(x_0)} maps into A under the induced map.
The resulting morphism Spec(A) to Spec(S_{(x_0)}) = D_+(x_0) fills the valuative diagram.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a standard open, order the generator images by vanishing, pick the minimal valuation index, run the displayed inequality, and conclude with the affine morphism.
difficulty_reason: Valuation-minimizing index selection with an explicit degree and valuation inequality computation; fully displayed.
